name: forest
prompt:

Images 1 (Tamariel) and 2 (Golems) are STYLE REFERENCES ONLY: use their sculpted painted 3D planes, graphic black silhouettes, textured color-block backgrounds, luminous edges and bold stylized faces. Do not reproduce either character, wings, workshop, labels or costume. Established inspirations: Arcane's hand-painted dimensional animation, Spider-Verse's screen-print halftones and deliberately misregistered color outlines, Sandman's surreal metaphysical dream logic. Make that visible in the artwork, not conventional oil-painted medieval fantasy.
SCENE: in an ancient forest at twilight, a single living tree's trunk is interrupted at chest height by a perfectly empty horizontal span. Its upper trunk and immense crown remain suspended, lower trunk rooted. In this small gap, an impossible VAST SILENT PROCESSION appears in depth: slender nonhuman negative-space shapes walk sideways through a space thinner than a hand, each step shifts which forest trees are near one another. They are anomalous appearances, not identified angels or dead souls. The impossibility is relational perspective, not a round glowing portal. One shape has stopped and subtly turned toward the witness. Foliage above the gap has an angular ivory inversion, below it saturated teal-black and vermilion print shadows. Float a few leaves on different perspective planes, paper-grain fractured geometry. Strong readable asymmetry, heroic-scale negative space, eerie hush, towering graphic silhouette.
HUMAN protagonist NAEL, 29, tiny but clear foreground fullbody three-quarter profile: lean angular warm olive face, dark wavy hair shaved at temples with long untidy forelock, dark brown eyes, no beard; short asymmetrical bone-white weather-worn rain cape over charcoal fitted travel layers, vermilion knot at throat, wrapped calves, practical boots, folded leather survey pouch, simple measuring cord. He is an ordinary woodland trail guide, frozen midstep, not an armored warrior. One little detached inset closeup of his frightened stylized eye at extreme left margin, a comic-page device without borders or words.
Palette ultramarine midnight, petrol teal, chalk ivory, vermilion with minimal acid-gold glints. Shapes and face paint visibly faceted, hard graphic decisions, sparse halftone texture, gritty printing, cinematic focus. No photorealism, sepia medieval painting, detailed fantasy armor, magical fireball, wings, generic giant deity, readable text, title, logos, watermark or decorative golden frame. Artwork used as the first chapter opening, full bleed. The forest feels physical, the gap feels like a failure of how space relates.
